name: Solid
tagline: Agents with their own computers, accounts, and budgets.
description: Solid’s AI agents build apps, automate workflows and tackle work you lack the time or expertise for. They pick and set up their own real machines, create accounts and pay for services. They use your apps through APIs or log in like a person. They build what’s missing and fix problems along the way. Think beyond personal agents like Grok Bot and Muse: Solid is built for complex, long-running work for you and your team. Close your laptop. Solid owns the job from start to finish.

name: Naise AI
tagline: Autonomous marketing agents that actually execute
description: Stop babysitting AI's empty text boxes. Naise AI gives founders and lean teams the output of a full marketing department without the overhead. Lock in your brand guidelines with Persistent Memory, select an Prompt Playbook, and let the platform handle the execution. From vetting real influencers and pitching to journalists, to generating and scheduling social content natively. Go from a cold start to live campaigns in under 24 hours, saving 40+ hours a week and cutting your marketing costs.

name: Claude Opus 5.5
tagline: Anthropic's first model in their new Claude 5.5 family
description: Claude Opus 5.5 is Anthropic’s latest model for agentic coding and knowledge work, delivering major performance gains, clearer communication, stronger safety, and 40% lower cost than Opus 5 on typical workloads.

name: Pactto
tagline: The room where creative teams align and AI takes action
description: Pactto is a new AI platform for creative teams to present work at studio quality, review assets assisted by AI agents that understand creative intent, capture every note, and can make changes live. Unlike Zoom or Google Meet, where context disappears when the call ends, Pactto rooms remember everything. Every conversation, every decision, every piece of feedback.

name: ToneBird
tagline: AI reply assistant that remembers your relationships
description: ToneBird is an AI reply assistant for Mac and Windows. It remembers your relationships, uses conversation history and connected files, and drafts replies in your voice inside Gmail, Slack, and other supported apps. You review and send.

name: AgentScore
tagline: Daily score to see if your agent gets better
description: Connect your production agent to Latitude and get a quality score across outcome, reliability, cost, speed, and safety. It updates daily, so you always know whether your agent is improving or getting worse.

name: Alexandria by Firecrawl
tagline: The knowledge library for superintelligence
description: Give AI agents direct access to data providers, specialized indexes and entire datasets through one connection. AI agents with Alexandria scored 21% higher on answer quality than with built-in web tools. Available through Firecrawl’s MCP, CLI and API.

name: Lightmeter
tagline: Film Camera designed for everyday moments
description: A real light meter when you carry film, and a film camera when you don't. Film looks built on true RAW capture - grain, halation and color that behave like film, not a filter on a flat photo. No AI, no account, nothing leaves your phone.

description: Most AI SEO tools tell you where you're mentioned and stop. RankControl runs the full lifecycle: create content that AI and Google recommend, published as native posts on your own domain. One flat plan, 7-day free trial.

name: GBrain
tagline: Garry Tan's AI memory, tools, & skills for any harness
description: GBrain gives you a memory and a set of connected accounts that every AI can reach. Write a note in Claude Code and ChatGPT knows it. Connect Gmail once and Cursor can search it with no key in a config file. The memory is a folder of markdown files you can read, correct and take with you. Run it on your own inference or ours, in a workspace your whole team shares. $100 off the first month for a team workspace at https://gbrain.io/gratis/product-hunt

name: Jev State
tagline: Turn AI conversations into tests and runnable code
description: Build and test conversational workflows with Jev. See why each step happened, save conversations as tests, and catch wrong turns before you ship. Export runnable TypeScript, workflow JSON, and an integration skill for your coding agent. Free and open source. Bring your own key for live runs.

name: Speechka
tagline: Real-time voice translation that sounds like you
description: Speak naturally. Speechka translates your speech in real time and delivers it in your own voice across 44 languages. Use it for meetings, calls, livestreams, presentations, and conferences on macOS or Windows. Or try the full experience directly in your browser for free, with no installation required.

name: Koreshield
tagline: Security and evidence for AI support agents
description: Every AI support agent takes input from someone it should not trust: the customer message, the documents it retrieves, and the tool calls it proposes. Koreshield screens all three before they become trusted model behavior or application execution. Data leaks, hidden instructions in help articles, policy drift and unsafe agent actions are checked before the model acts, and every decision is recorded. One call to integrate.

name: Linguo Translate
tagline: Offline & AI Translation for macOS
description: Linguo is a translator located in the macOS menu bar. You can translate using the menu bar icon with offline support for 22 languages or use AI translation with Apple Intelligence, Gemini, OpenAI, or Anthropic. It allows you to switch easily between native translations and AI translations.

name: CodeSpotlight
tagline: Make your code impossible to miss.
description: CodeSpotlight makes selected code visually stand out in IntelliJ IDEA with customizable animated effects. Built for coding YouTubers, tutors, instructors, course creators, livestreamers, technical presenters, and anyone who wants their code to be impossible to miss.

name: Rumora
tagline: Place your product in comments on videos going viral
description: Rumora places your product in the comments of videos going viral in your niche, from a network of up to 50,000 accounts. You do not make the video, buy the ad, or connect your own profiles. A first comment that sounds like a real user. Replies that keep the thread going. Upvotes so it sits where people read. TikTok, YouTube, and soon Instagram. Built for bootstrappers shy of camera and with no ad budget. Free in preview: claim 500 credits and we plant the first rumor for you.

name: IconsDB
tagline: AI powered search across 200K+ free icons.
description: Stop guessing icon names. Describe what you need ("sad robot," "money leaving") and find it instantly across 200K+ icons from Lucide, Heroicons, Phosphor, Material and 80 more sets. Copy as SVG, React, Vue or CSS.

name: Nimply
tagline: Hire AI agents that run your social media - you approve
description: Nimply is an AI social media workforce. Hire agents from a gallery: support replies, lead capture, moderation, ghostwriting, carousels, repurposing and trend scouting. They work on top of a full platform, with a planner publishing to 9 networks, a unified inbox and a visual automation canvas. The rule that matters: agents draft, you approve. They cannot publish without you. Free plan, no card. Paid from $9.99/mo. iOS, Android, browser extension, public API and MCP server included.

name: blognice
tagline: Simple, privacy-first blogging you truly own
description: Blognice is a simple, privacy-first platform for running one or multiple blogs without WordPress maintenance, platform lock-in, or complicated publishing tools. Manage every blog from one account, connect custom domains, publish unlimited posts, and retain ownership of your content and data. Use the hosted service or self-host the open-source core.
